title: Warnung!
body:
Hier wird abgezockt, habe soeben entdeckt, dass, trotz Kündigung, 2 x 29,99€ abgezogen geworden ist.
Nach Kündigung bekommt man auch keine Bestätigung per Mail.
Einziger Weg lt meiner Bank die Zahlungen zu stoppen ist ein Karten Tausch.

author: Sirgsirg

title: Don’t get the App!
body: It’s a complete rip-off. If you get the 3 trial they will take off money, they won’t refund anything, it’s a business strategy. The trial is 3 days and it takes them 4 days to answer. They don’t offer solutions and just send you their policies. The app itself gives people the feeling that it’s their fault and makes it sound like “you are not trying hard enough”. It’s using the weakness of a group of people. Don’t get this app!

title: Scam
body: Die ziehen den zweiten Monat 39,99€ von meinem Konto ab, ohne dass ich überhaupt laut Kundenservice einen Account dort habe oder sie was finden können unter meiner Email und Apple id. Danach wurde ich geghosted. Ich hätte gerne ein Statement
author: Karriss2222

title: Am liebsten würd ich keinen Stern hergeben!!
body:
Die App hat mir garnichts gebracht außer Ärger. hab vor dem auslaufen des 3-Tages Test-Abos gekündigt was alleine schon ein Wahnsinn war da der Vorgang nirgens beschrieben ist. Nach abmelden und löschung dieser App und des Kontos hab ich einen Tag nachher eine Rechnung von 39,99€ bekommen. 
Kontakt mit dem Support komplett sinnlos reden sich nur auf deren Money-back-policy aus. Auf die Erklärung das ich nach dieser Policy mein Geld zurückbekommen müsste reagieren sie garnicht. 
Eigentlich eine Frechheit!!! Absoluter scam!
author: auf_den_scam_reingeflogen

title: Zero stars
body: This is a ripoff. No trial period. Charges immediately. In contact with Customer service for a month now and still no money back. They are basically trying to make the process so long that you wanna give up on getting your money back. Never again!
author: Starship0

title: Payment
body: I just wanted to test the offer, then I received the invoice that I had to cancel before the end of the offer period. No instructions where to go. Just an email address to which I sent the cancellation. Automatic message: Processing takes 4 business days, only trial version lasts up to 3 days, so I have to pay the price???! Why? Bad customer service!!
author: Leiden2024

title: Scam and the Customer service is really bad
body:
Buttons are selected in such a way that you suddenly buy a script and it is automatically debited.
This app promises to get an individual solution based on the test, that's not true. The subscription is simply sold and through the button they get even more money.
It says that if you cancel in time in the trial month, you will get your money back. That's not true, I've been discussing with customer service for over 3 weeks and no help.
The whole thing is just a big scam.

title: Not worth - sneaky misleading offer
body: Take care while installing they trick you by placing buttons on various positions that you buy journals not on purpose! Want my money back - european consumer ragulatuons do apply!

title: Issue with the app and unauthorized fund deduction
body: A very complex app that takes a long time to figure out. Be cautious, as in a few days, $30 will be charged without your knowledge. Even if you didn't like the app and wrote about it immediately, they won't refund your money. Terrible customer service! The app is supposed to help you take care of yourself, but instead, it just causes stress.
